comparison.objective: Select, mount, lock, and set an inverted zoom lens to 50 mm.
comparison.physical_skill: Lens selection, bayonet mounting, locking, and friction-sensitive ring adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Compatible lens remains mounted and retains 50 mm after release; numeric tolerance is absent in this record.
comparison.reason: It tests component selection and passive zoom-ring retention, not preservation of a screw stop during locknut tightening and repeated mechanism cycles.
